about.title: About FNF Foundation Repair
text: FNF Foundation Repair delivers expert foundation repair across Greater Houston — slab, pier & beam, house leveling, and under-slab tunneling. Locally owned and operated. Free inspections. Lifetime transferable warranty.
For older Houston homes with wood framing and crawl spaces. We restore shifting support beams, replace rotted wood, and eliminate moisture damage.
Nearly half of Houston-area structures experience slab cracking. We lift settled slabs, seal cracks, and stabilize your foundation against further movement.
